spans.s: 1. अग, अस्, m. a snake; the sun; a water-jar.

अग 2. अ-ग, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. गम्), unable
to walk; unapproachable; (अस्), m. a mountain, a
tree; (in arithm.) seven.
—अग-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, pro-
duced on a mountain, or from a tree; (अम्), n.
bitumen.
—अगात्मजा (अग-आत्˚), f., N. of Pārvatī,
the daughter of Himālaya.
—अगावह (अग-आव्˚), अस्,
m., N. of a son of Kṛṣṇa and of others.
—अगौकस्
(अग-ओक्˚), आस्, m. a lion; a bird; the śarabha, a
fabulous animal with eight legs.
अगा अ-गा, आस्, m. f., Ved. not going.
आग 1. आग = आगस् in अन्-आग, q. v.

2. आ-ग, अस्, आ, अम्, accidental; happening acci-
dentally.
—आग-त्व, अम्, n. accident, chance.
2. आ-गा, आस्, आस्, अम्, coming towards, &c.
अ-गच्छ, अस्, आ, अम्, not going; (अस्), m. a tree.

अगणित अ-गणित, अस्, आ, अम्, uncounted.
—अगणित-लज्ज, अस्, आ, अम्, disregarding shame.

अगत अ-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, not gone; unfre-
quented; (अम्), n., Ved. not coming, non-return (?).

आ-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, come, arrived; occurred, hap-
pened; living or residing in; returned; fallen to one's
share; fallen into; received, obtained; passed; (अम्),
n. occurrence, event [cf. अन्-आगत, स्व्-आगत].
—आगत-क्षोभ, अस्, आ, अम्, confounded, perplexed.
—आगत-साध्वस, अस्, आ, अम्, terrified, afraid.
अ-गति, इस्, f. want of resort or resource, necessity.

आ-गति, इस्, f. arrival, coming; return; origin; ac-
cident, chance.

अ-गतिक or अ-गतीक, अस्, आ, अम्, destitute of re-
sort or of resources.
—अगतिक-गति, इस्, f. the resort
of one who has no resort, a last resource.

अगद अ-गद, अस्, आ, अम्, free from disease,
healthy, salubrious; free from judicial affliction; (अस्),
m. freedom from disease, health; a medicine, medi-
cament, drug; the science of antidotes.
—अगदङ्-
कार, अस्, ई, m. f. a physician, (‘who makes well.’)
अगद्य, nom. P. अगद्यति, to have good health.
अगदित अ-गदित, अस्, आ, अम्, untold.

अगम अ-गम, अस्, आ, अम्, not going, unable
to go; (अस्), m. a mountain, a tree [cf. 2. अ-ग].

आ-गम, अस्, आ, अम्, coming near, approaching,
supplying; (अस्), m. arrival, appearance; coming,
approach; addition; course; the mouth of a river;
supply of money, income, revenue; increase of pro-
perty (especially in the compound अर्थागम), lawful
acquisition of anything; increase of knowledge (espe-
cially in the compound विद्यागम); knowledge,
science, intelligence; a traditional doctrine or precept,
a collection of such doctrines or precepts, a sacred
work, scripture; a manual; an affix; the interpola-
tion of a letter in grammar, a grammatical augment,
a meaningless syllable or letter inserted in any part of
the radical word; record, title-deed, legal title, a
voucher or written testimony; (अम्), n. a Tantra or
any work inculcating the mystical worship of Śiva
and Śakti.
—आगम-निरपेक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, inde-
pendent of a written voucher or title.
—आगम-नीत,
अस्, आ, अम्, studied, read, examined.
—आगम-रहित,
अस्, आ, अम्, devoid of a written title or a voucher;
without a Śāstra.
—आगम-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having an
augment or addition of any kind; having approached
for sexual intercourse.
—आगम-सापेक्ष, अस्, आ,
अम्, with or supported by legal vouchers.
—आगमा-
पायिन् (˚म-अप्˚), ई, इनी, इ, transient, of short dura-
tion.
—आगमावर्ता (˚म-आव्˚), f., N. of the plant
Tragia Involucrata Lin.

अ-गम्य or अ-गन्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, unfit to
be walked in, or to be approached; inaccessible
(physically or metaphorically), inapproachable; un-
attainable, incomprehensible, unsurpassable.
—अग-
म्य-रूप, अस्, आ, अम्, of unsurpassed form, nature,
or beauty.
—अगम्या-गमन, अम्, n. illicit sexual
intercourse.
—अगम्यागमनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, relat-
ing to illicit intercourse.
—अगम्या-गामिन्, ई, इनी, इ,
practising illicit intercourse.

1. आ-गम्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be approached, accessi-
ble; to be acquired.
2. आ-गम्य, ind. having arrived or come.

अगरी अ-गरी, f. a kind of grass, commonly
called Deotar, Andropogon Serratus [cf. गरी].

अगरु अगरु, उस्, उ, m. n. Agallochum,
Amyris Agallocha.
अगर्व अ-गर्व, अस्, आ, अम्, free from pride.

अगर्हित अ-गर्हित, अस्, आ, अम्, undespised,
unreproached, blameless.

अगव्यूति अ-गव्यूति, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. without
good pasturage for cattle, barren.

अगस्ति अगस्ति, इस्, m. (said to be fr. 2. अ-ग,
a mountain, and अस्ति, fr. rt. 2. अस्, thrower), N. of a
Ṛṣi, author of several Vedic hymns, (he is said to
have been the son of both Mitra and Varuṇa by
Urvasī; to have been born in a water-jar; to have
been of short stature; to have swallowed the ocean,
and compelled the Vindhya mountains to prostrate
themselves before him; to have conquered and civi-
lized the South; to have written on medicine, &c.);
the star Canopus, of which Agastya is the regent;
a plant, Sesbana (or Æschynomene) Grandiflora.
—अगस्ति-द्रु, उस्, f. a plant, Sesbana Grandiflora.
अगस्ती, f. a female descendant of Agastya.
अगस्तयस्, m. pl. the descendants of Agastya.
अगस्तीय, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to Agasti.

आगस्तीय, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to or tending to the
advantage of Agasti.

अगस्त्य, अ, m. = अगस्ति, N. of Śiva.
—अगस्त्य-गीता,
आस्, f. pl. Agastya's hymns, forming part of the Ādi-
vārāha-Purāṇa.
—अगस्त्य-चार, अस्, m. the course of
Canopus.
—अगस्त्य-संहिता, f. Agastya's collection
(of law).
—अगस्त्योदय (˚य-उद्˚), अस्, m. the rise of
Canopus; the seventh day of the second half of Bhādra.

अगस्त्य; correct thus — अस्, m. = अगस्ति; and
add — in Raghu-v.
XIII. 36

. Agastya is said to be
‘the cleanser of water,’ as on the rising of Canopus
turbid waters become clear.

आगस्त्य आगस्त्य, अस्, आ, अम्, referring to the
sage Agasti, q. v.; originating from the plant Agasti
Grandiflorum.

अगाध अ-गाध, अस्, आ, अम् (see गाध),
very deep, unfathomable, bottomless; (अस्, अम्), m.
n. a hole, chasm; (अस्), m., N. of one of the five fires
at the Svāhākāra [cf. Gr. ἀγαθός and Goth. gôths,
fr. the crude form gôda].
—अगाध-जल, अस्, आ, अम्,
having deep water; (अस्), m. a deep lake.
आगाध आगाध = अ-गाध, q. v.

अगार अ-गार, अस्, अम्, m. n. house, apart-
ment [cf. आ-गार].
आगर आगर, Ved. = आ-गार (?).

आगार आ-गार, अम्, n. (probably fr. आ-गॄ,
‘to swallow down,’ and denoting first any inner re-
ceptacle), room, covered place, dwelling, house, recep-
tacle [cf. अ-गार].
—आगार-गोधिका, f. a lizard (?).
—आगार-दाह, अस्, m. arson, setting a house on
fire.
—आगार-दाहिन्, ई, m. an incendiary.
—आगार-
धूम, अस्, m., N. of a plant.

आगम् आ-गम्, cl. 1. P. -गच्छति, -गन्तुम्,
to come; to make one's appearance; to come near,
go towards or to or into; to arrive at, attain, reach,
[]
strike; to return; to fall into (any state of mind);
have recourse to: Caus. P. -गमयति, -यितुम्, to
cause to come near; to lead towards; to convey; to
announce the arrival (of any one); to obtain inform-
ation about anything, ascertain (with acc.); A. to
wait for, to have patience: Intens. Ved. -गनीगन्ति,
to approach repeatedly: Desid. -जिगमिषति, to be
about to come.
आ-गत्य, ind. having come, having arrived.

आ-गन्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be arrived, what is
likely to arrive; to be come to (with acc. or loc.
of the place); obliged to come.

आ-गन्तु, उस्, उस्, उ, coming, arriving; what is
added, adhering; coming from the outside, external;
adventitious, incidental; (उस्), m. a new comer, a
stranger, a guest; an accident, any accidental hurt or
wound
—आगन्तु-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, arising accidentally.
आ-गान्तु, उस्, m. a guest. See आ-गन्तु.

आगन्तुक, अस्, आ, or ई, अम्, coming, arriving; ar-
riving of one's own accord; stray; incidental, acci-
dental, adventitious (as pleasure, pain, ornament, &c.);
(अस्), m. a new comer, a stranger, a guest; an inter-
polated पाठ or various reading (which has crept
in without authority).

आ-गमन, अम्, n. coming, approaching, arriving;
returning; arising; approaching a woman for sexual
intercourse.
—आगमन-कारण, अम्, n. reason of
one's coming.
—आगमन-तस्, ind. on account of
an arrival.
आ-गमय्य, ind. having explored or discovered.

आ-गमित, अस्, आ, अम्, read over, perused, studied;
understood, ascertained.
आगमिन्, ई, इनी, इ, (in gram.) receiving an augment.

आ-गामिन्, ई, इनी, इ, coming, about to come, ar-
riving, impending; future.
—आगामि-काल, अस्, m.
future time.

आ-गमिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम् (superl.), Ved. coming
with pleasure or very quickly.

आगामिक, अस्, आ, अम्, relating or belonging to the
future.
आ-गामुक, अस्, आ, अम्, coming, arriving; future.

आगलित आ-गलित, अस्, आ, अम्, drooping,
languishing, dejected.

आगविष्ठ आ-गविष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम् (either a
false reading for आ-गमिष्ठ or fr. an adj. आ-गु),
Ved. coming near (?).

आगवीन आ-गवीन, अस्, आ, अम्, occupied with
any business till the return of the cows.

आगस् आगस्, अस्, n. (said to be fr. rt. इ with
आग substituted), transgression, offence, sin, fault [cf.
Gr. ἄγος].
—आगस्-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, offending;
offended.
आ-गातृ, ता, त्री, तृ, obtaining by singing.
आ-गान, अम्, n. the act of obtaining by song.
